question: If a read request includes any minimum-position control, should it require exactly one valid value for all three fields (minimum position, Scope epoch and authorization view), rejecting missing, repeated or malformed fields with400 before reading state? Recommended closed tuple rule; valid-but-unknown positions separate.
decision: All three absent means no minimum; any presence requires exactly one nonempty lexically valid token per field; malformed tuples return400malformed-request after normal transport/method/auth checks.
